title: Hades
how: You fight your way out of the Underworld one room at a time, picking a power-up from the gods after each battle. When you die, you return to your home base and try again a little stronger.
mechanics: Fast dash-and-strike combat, six weapons, randomized upgrades during each run, and permanent unlocks between runs.
objective: Escape the Underworld and find out why your family keeps pulling you back.
style: Hand-painted, stylish and voice-acted, with a story that moves forward with every attempt.

title: Elden Ring
how: You explore a huge open world on foot and horseback, choosing where to go and which bosses to face. Fights are tough and reward patience and timing.
mechanics: Stamina-based melee and magic combat, a deep build system, and summonable helpers and spirits.
objective: Gather the shards of a broken power and become the ruler of the Lands Between.
style: Dark fantasy with sweeping landscapes and very little hand-holding.

title: Celeste
how: You guide Madeline up a mountain through short, hand-built screens that each ask you to solve a jumping puzzle. Failing is quick and restarting is instant.
mechanics: Jump, wall-climb and one air dash, with tight controls and optional assist settings to tune the difficulty.
objective: Reach the summit of Celeste Mountain while facing your own doubts.
style: Colorful pixel art, a moving soundtrack, and a warm, personal story.

title: Hollow Knight
how: You explore a sprawling underground insect kingdom, unlocking new abilities that open up areas you couldn't reach before. Battles are precise and bosses are memorable.
mechanics: Nail-swing combat, healing by focus, equippable charms, and a map you have to earn and fill in.
objective: Descend into Hallownest and uncover the source of the infection that ruined it.
style: Moody hand-drawn art and a quiet, mysterious tone.

title: Baldur's Gate 3
how: You lead a party of companions through a story where your choices change who lives, who helps you and how scenes play out. Combat happens in turns on a grid.
mechanics: Dungeons & Dragons rules with dice rolls, spells, terrain and positioning, plus co-op for up to four players.
objective: Get rid of the parasite in your head and decide what to do with the power it gives you.
style: Cinematic, funny and dramatic, with an enormous amount of branching dialogue.

title: Stardew Valley
how: You take over a run-down family farm and build a new life: planting crops, raising animals, mining, fishing and getting to know the townspeople.
mechanics: A day-and-season calendar, energy management, crafting, relationships and a light combat system in the mines.
objective: Restore the farm and the community at your own pace. There is no timer and no single way to win.
style: Cozy pixel art and relaxed music that makes it easy to play one more day.

title: Sid Meier's Civilization VI
how: You lead a civilization from the ancient era to the modern world, taking turns to found cities, research technology and deal with rival leaders.
mechanics: Turn-based empire building with districts, trade, diplomacy, culture, faith and war.
objective: Win through science, culture, religion, conquest or by having the highest score when time runs out.
style: Colorful, board-game-like maps with a calm, thoughtful pace.

title: Into the Breach
how: You command three mechs on a tiny grid against alien monsters. The game shows you exactly what each enemy will do next, and your job is to stop it.
mechanics: Turn-based tactics where you push, pull and reposition enemies so their attacks miss or hit each other.
objective: Protect the city buildings and survive long enough to save the timeline.
style: Clean pixel art and short, replayable runs that feel like puzzles.

title: Portal 2
how: In first person, you solve test chambers by placing two linked portals on walls and floors and carrying momentum through them.
mechanics: The portal gun, light bridges, gels and lasers, plus a separate two-player co-op campaign.
objective: Get through the test chambers and escape the Aperture Science facility.
style: Sharp, dry humor and clever level design that teaches you as you play.

title: Tetris Effect: Connected
how: You rotate and drop falling blocks to complete lines, while the music and visuals react to every move you make.
mechanics: Classic block-stacking with a Zone ability that briefly freezes time, plus solo and multiplayer modes.
objective: Clear lines to survive and score as high as you can through each themed stage.
style: Music-driven and hypnotic, a bit like playing inside a light show.

title: Forza Horizon 5
how: You drive freely across a large open world set in Mexico, entering road, dirt and cross-country races or just exploring and collecting cars.
mechanics: Hundreds of cars, tuning, adjustable driving assists, seasons that change the terrain, and online events.
objective: Grow your festival by winning events and building a garage of your dream cars.
style: Bright, sunny and energetic, built for relaxed cruising as much as racing.

title: Mario Kart 8 Deluxe
how: You race quirky karts around colorful tracks, grabbing item boxes to attack rivals or boost ahead.
mechanics: Drifting for speed boosts, anti-gravity sections, a wide range of items, and local or online multiplayer.
objective: Finish first in each cup and beat your friends.
style: Light-hearted and easy to pick up, great for playing with people of any skill level.

title: Rocket League
how: You play soccer with rocket-powered cars, teaming up to knock a giant ball into the other team's goal.
mechanics: Boost pickups, jumping and flipping, and mid-air hits, usually in short 3-versus-3 matches.
objective: Score more goals than the other team before the clock runs out.
style: Fast, loud and easy to understand, with a high skill ceiling for those who want it.

title: Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 1 + 2
how: You skate through real-feeling park and street levels, chaining tricks into big combos within a timed run.
mechanics: Ollies, grinds, manuals and lip tricks, with goals like collecting letters and hitting score targets in each level.
objective: Complete each level's goals and rack up the highest scores.
style: Loose, arcade skating with a loud punk-flavored attitude.

title: Cities: Skylines
how: You start with an empty patch of land and lay out roads, zones and services to grow a city while keeping the budget healthy.
mechanics: Zoning, traffic flow, utilities, public transport, taxes and a large community of mods.
objective: Build a thriving city. There's no fixed ending, only the one you design.
style: Calm and creative, with a map you can zoom right down to street level.

title: Slay the Spire
how: You climb a tower one fight at a time, adding cards to your deck and choosing paths on a branching map. If you die, you start over with what you learned.
mechanics: Deck-building and turn-based card combat with relics that change your strategy.
objective: Reach the top of the Spire and defeat what waits there.
style: Simple, comic-style visuals with runs that take under an hour.

title: Disco Elysium
how: You wake up as an amnesiac detective and investigate a murder mainly by talking to people, reading and making choices. There is no traditional combat.
mechanics: Skill checks decided by dice, with your skills speaking up as opinionated voices in your head.
objective: Solve the murder case and figure out who you are.
style: Painted, text-heavy and darkly funny, closer to an interactive novel.

title: Resident Evil 4
how: You play a government agent sent to rescue a kidnapped daughter from a remote village, fighting off infected villagers in tense third-person combat.
mechanics: Limited ammo and inventory space, a knife you can use to parry, and a merchant who sells upgrades.
objective: Find and rescue the president's daughter and escape alive.
style: Cinematic survival horror with plenty of action and some wonderfully over-the-top moments.

title: Balatro
how: You play poker hands to score enough points to beat each round, then buy special cards that bend the rules in your favor.
mechanics: Poker hand scoring combined with roguelike deck-building and hundreds of game-changing joker cards.
objective: Beat all the rounds through eight antes by building a scoring engine.
style: Retro CRT-style visuals and quick runs that are easy to start and hard to stop.

title: Persona 5 Royal
how: You live as a high school student by day and a masked thief by night, balancing school life and friendships with dungeon crawls.
mechanics: Turn-based combat that rewards hitting enemy weaknesses, a daily calendar and relationship building.
objective: Change the hearts of corrupt adults and uncover the conspiracy behind them.
style: Extremely stylish, with jazzy music and bold, graphic menus.

title: Minecraft
how: You explore a world made of blocks, gathering resources, crafting tools and building whatever you can imagine.
mechanics: Mining, crafting and survival against monsters, or Creative mode with unlimited blocks, plus multiplayer.
objective: Set your own goals. You can also travel far enough to take on the Ender Dragon.
style: Simple blocky graphics with room for endless creativity.

title: Apex Legends
how: Squads of three drop onto a large map, scavenge weapons and fight until only one squad is left standing.
mechanics: Hero characters with unique abilities, sliding and climbing movement, and a ping system for teamwork.
objective: Be the last squad alive in each match.
style: Fast, competitive sci-fi shooting that rewards good communication.

title: The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom
how: You explore the land of Hyrule, its floating sky islands and the caves below, solving problems in whatever way you can think of.
mechanics: Building vehicles and gadgets from parts you find, fusing items to weapons, and physics-based puzzles.
objective: Find Zelda and stop the evil that has returned to threaten the kingdom.
style: Bright, painterly and full of surprises, where experimenting is the main reward.

title: Lethal Company
how: You and up to three friends land on abandoned moons to collect scrap, while dangerous creatures roam the dark corridors.
mechanics: Co-op scavenging, a quota that rises each round, and proximity voice chat so you can only hear nearby players.
objective: Meet the company's scrap quota without losing your crew.
style: Low-resolution retro visuals, and a mix of real panic and goofy laughs.

title: Clair Obscur: Expedition 33
how: You lead an expedition on a doomed mission to stop a being that erases everyone of a certain age each year. Combat is turn-based but you dodge and parry in real time.
mechanics: Turn-based battles with active dodging, parrying and counterattacking, and a flexible skill system.
objective: Reach and defeat the Paintress before your expedition runs out of time.
style: A painterly fantasy world inspired by Belle Epoque France, with a dramatic orchestral tone.

title: Factorio
how: You crash-land on an alien planet and gradually build larger and larger automated factories, while fending off local creatures.
mechanics: Mining, crafting, conveyor belts, power networks and production lines that you keep improving.
objective: Build a rocket and launch it off the planet.
style: Top-down and systems-focused, perfect for people who love optimizing.

title: Dave the Diver
how: You dive into the mysterious Blue Hole during the day to catch fish, then run a sushi restaurant at night with what you caught.
mechanics: Underwater exploration and fishing, restaurant management, crafting and upgrades, all in one loop.
objective: Uncover the secrets of the Blue Hole while growing a successful restaurant.
style: Charming pixel art with a cheerful, quirky sense of humor.

title: PAC-MAN
how: Navigate a maze, clearing pellets while avoiding four ghosts. Power pellets briefly let Pac-Man turn and chase them.
mechanics: Grid-based movement, maze routes, power pellets, bonus fruit, and ghosts with distinct behaviors.
objective: Clear each maze of pellets, avoid losing all lives, and build the highest score you can.
style: Bright maze graphics, bold character shapes, distinctive ghost colors, and classic arcade sound effects.

title: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt
how: Play as Geralt, investigating monster contracts across a sprawling world where conversations and choices can reshape outcomes and relationships.
mechanics: Third-person action combat, signs (magic), quest-driven exploration, and branching decisions that affect quests, factions, and endings.
objective: Hunt the Wild Hunt and uncover the truth behind Ciriâ€™s fate.
style: Dark fantasy with dense writing, cinematic character moments, and a lived-in open world.

title: God of War (2018)
how: Travel through Norse realms with Kratos as you fight enemies, solve hazards, and advance a personal story.
mechanics: Heavy melee combat with block and counter timing, weapon upgrades, environmental traversal, and cinematic fights.
objective: Complete a journey with Atreus while facing the consequences of the godsâ€™ plans.
style: Mythic Norse landscapes, close camera work, and grounded character drama.

title: The Last of Us Part I
how: Guide Joel and Ellie across a dangerous post-pandemic United States while navigating hostile groups and infected.
mechanics: Third-person combat, stealth, scavenging, crafting, and resource management through story-led encounters.
objective: Escort Ellie across the country in search of a possible cure.
style: Cinematic character storytelling with tense, grounded survival horror.

title: Uncharted 4: A Thiefâ€™s End
how: Pursue lost treasure across dramatic locations, alternating exploration and climbing with firefights and set pieces.
mechanics: Third-person shooting, melee combat, platforming, climbing, light puzzles, and vehicle sequences.
objective: Find the lost pirate colony of Libertalia and uncover the truth behind its treasure.
style: Swashbuckling cinematic adventure with detailed environments and character-focused storytelling.

title: Ghost of Tsushima
how: Defend Tsushima from a Mongol invasion, choosing whether to confront enemies openly or use stealth.
mechanics: Open-world exploration, stance-based sword combat, stealth, duels, and side quests.
objective: Drive the invaders from Tsushima and protect its people.
style: Cinematic samurai drama set among painterly landscapes and atmospheric weather.

title: Sekiro: Shadows Die Twice
how: Fight through a dangerous version of Sengoku-era Japan, learning enemy patterns and mastering precise sword duels.
mechanics: Posture-based sword fights, timed deflections, stealth, grappling movement, and prosthetic tools.
objective: Protect the young lord and confront the forces pursuing his supernatural power.
style: Austere historical fantasy focused on precise, high-stakes combat.

title: Bloodborne
how: Hunt through a plague-stricken gothic city, facing dangerous creatures and uncovering the source of its nightmare.
mechanics: Third-person melee combat, stamina management, transforming weapons, and a rally system that rewards aggressive play.
objective: Survive the hunt and reveal the truth behind Yharnamâ€™s transformation.
style: Gothic architecture, cosmic horror, and fast, demanding boss fights.

title: Monster Hunter: World
how: Track and hunt large monsters in expeditions, then use the materials to prepare for tougher hunts.
mechanics: Distinct weapon classes, stamina and positioning, monster tracking, crafting, and optional online co-op.
objective: Complete assignments and investigate the New Worldâ€™s ecosystem and elder dragons.
style: Detailed natural environments and deliberate, weighty monster battles.

title: Final Fantasy VII Remake
how: Follow Cloud and the Avalanche group through a story-driven reimagining of Midgar.
mechanics: Real-time party combat with tactical pauses, character switching, abilities, spells, and equipment builds.
objective: Challenge Shinraâ€™s control of Midgar and uncover the forces changing the groupâ€™s fate.
style: Cinematic science-fantasy with detailed characters and dramatic set pieces.

title: Chrono Trigger
how: Travel across several eras with a party of heroes, uncovering how their choices connect to a coming catastrophe.
mechanics: Turn-based battles with timed inputs, combined party techniques, exploration, and multiple endings.
objective: Stop a world-ending threat whose origins stretch across time.
style: Colorful fantasy science-fiction with expressive pixel art and a memorable score.

title: The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim
how: Roam Skyrim freely, following the main quest, joining factions, or taking on side quests as you choose.
mechanics: Open-world exploration, skill-based character progression, melee, ranged and magic combat, and crafting.
objective: Face the return of dragons while deciding how to shape your characterâ€™s path.
style: Expansive northern fantasy landscapes, ancient ruins, and player-directed adventure.

title: Dragon Age: Inquisition
how: Lead the Inquisition as a magical breach threatens Thedas, building alliances and making choices that shape the conflict.
mechanics: Party-based combat, tactical commands, character builds, companion quests, and branching decisions.
objective: Close the breach and confront the force behind the growing crisis.
style: High fantasy with cinematic conversations, companion stories, and large explorable regions.

title: Undertale
how: Explore an underground world and choose how to respond to the monsters you meet.
mechanics: Turn-based encounters with bullet-dodging sequences, dialogue choices, and nonviolent ways to resolve fights.
objective: Find a way out of the Underground while deciding the fate of its inhabitants.
style: Quirky pixel art, playful music, and an emotionally responsive story.

title: Dead Cells
how: Fight through shifting areas, adapting your build as each run leads to new routes and challenges.
mechanics: Fast 2D melee and ranged combat, randomized gear, permanent unlocks, and interconnected paths.
objective: Reach the islandâ€™s final threats while learning more about the spreading malaise.
style: Fluid pixel-art action with quick restarts and demanding combat.

title: Ori and the Will of the Wisps
how: Guide Ori through a connected world, gaining movement abilities to reach new areas and find lost friends.
mechanics: Precision platforming, traversal abilities, melee combat, map exploration, and upgradeable shards.
objective: Restore the forest and uncover the mystery threatening Niwen.
style: Lush hand-painted environments, expressive animation, and an orchestral score.

title: Cuphead
how: Take on challenging boss encounters and run-and-gun levels while learning each enemyâ€™s attack patterns.
mechanics: Side-scrolling shooting, jumping, dashing, parries, weapon choices, and optional local co-op.
objective: Collect the debtorsâ€™ contracts and settle Cuphead and Mugmanâ€™s bargain with the Devil.
style: Hand-drawn animation inspired by 1930s cartoons, with a big-band soundtrack.

title: Spelunky 2
how: Descend through procedurally generated caves, navigating traps, creatures, and the consequences of your choices.
mechanics: Permadeath runs, physics-driven platforming, equipment, branching routes, and optional multiplayer.
objective: Survive the caves and uncover what lies beyond their deepest regions.
style: Playful pixel-art adventure with intricate systems and punishing surprises.

title: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth
how: Guide Isaac through randomized rooms filled with enemies and hazards, collecting items that reshape each run.
mechanics: Top-down projectile combat, procedural floors, permanent unlocks, and item combinations with varied effects.
objective: Descend through a series of hostile areas and defeat the threats at the end of a run.
style: Darkly comic, surreal imagery paired with fast, replayable dungeon runs.

title: Risk of Rain 2
how: Explore alien stages and fight increasingly dangerous creatures as the runâ€™s difficulty steadily rises.
mechanics: Third-person shooting, character-specific abilities, item stacking, and randomized roguelite runs.
objective: Survive the planetâ€™s escalating threats and decide when to risk moving to the next stage.
style: Colorful science-fiction environments that build into chaotic, effects-filled battles.

title: Subnautica
how: Explore an alien ocean after a crash, gathering supplies and investigating what happened to your ship.
mechanics: First-person swimming, oxygen and health management, crafting, base building, and underwater vehicles.
objective: Learn how to survive on the planet and find a way to leave.
style: Immersive underwater vistas balance quiet wonder with deep-sea tension.

title: Outer Wilds
how: Investigate a small solar system, following clues left behind by an ancient civilization during a repeating time loop.
mechanics: Pilot a spaceship, explore planets on foot, solve environmental puzzles, and use knowledge to reach new clues.
objective: Uncover the mystery behind the solar systemâ€™s recurring end.
style: Hand-crafted science fiction with quiet exploration, nonlinear storytelling, and an expressive soundtrack.

title: Gran Turismo 7
how: Race cars across circuits and events, learning tracks and improving your collection over a structured campaign.
mechanics: Driving physics, car tuning, licenses, race events, and vehicle collection and upgrades.
objective: Complete events and build a garage spanning different types of motorsport.
style: Polished automotive presentation with detailed cars, circuits, and race replays.

title: It Takes Two
how: Play a two-player adventure where the characters must work together through a series of imaginative worlds.
mechanics: Co-op platforming and puzzles, with abilities that change from chapter to chapter.
objective: Help Cody and May work through their challenges and find a way back to normal.
style: Colorful storybook presentation with playful set pieces and varied level design.

title: Grand Theft Auto V
how: Follow three criminals across Los Santos as their lives converge around increasingly ambitious jobs.
mechanics: Open-world driving, shooting, melee combat, character switching, and mission-based heists.
objective: Carry out a series of high-risk heists while navigating the charactersâ€™ conflicts.
style: A satirical modern setting with cinematic missions and a sprawling city to explore.

title: Red Dead Redemption 2
how: Travel with the Van der Linde gang through a changing frontier as the group struggles to stay together.
mechanics: Open-world exploration, horseback travel, gunfights, hunting, and story missions.
objective: Help Arthur Morgan navigate the gangâ€™s final years and the choices that define them.
style: Detailed Western landscapes and a character-focused story paced by quiet and dramatic moments.

title: Street Fighter 6
how: Choose a fighter and battle through one-on-one matches against a rival or another player.
mechanics: Character-specific attacks, combos, special moves, and the Drive Gauge for offense and defense.
objective: Win rounds by reducing your opponentâ€™s health before time runs out.
style: Colorful 2D fighting arenas with expressive animation and a street-art visual influence.

title: Tekken 8
how: Fight one-on-one using a roster of martial artists, each with their own style and move set.
mechanics: Three-dimensional movement, long move lists, combos, and the Heat system that encourages aggressive play.
objective: Defeat your rival across rounds and matches.
style: Detailed character animation, dramatic effects, and cinematic presentation.

title: Mortal Kombat 1
how: Compete in one-on-one fights across a reimagined Mortal Kombat universe.
mechanics: Special moves, combo strings, blocking, and Kameo assists from a second fighter.
objective: Win each match by defeating your opponent in the allotted rounds.
style: Cinematic martial-arts fantasy with vivid arenas and graphic finishing moves.

title: Overwatch 2
how: Join a team of heroes and compete in objective-based matches against another team.
mechanics: First-person shooting, hero-specific abilities, team roles, and ultimate abilities that charge during play.
objective: Coordinate with your team to secure objectives and win the match.
style: Bright, stylized science-fiction heroes with readable effects and fast team fights.

title: Counter-Strike 2
how: Compete in round-based matches as attackers or defenders, where positioning and teamwork decide the outcome.
mechanics: First-person gunplay, recoil control, weapon buying, and tactical grenades including smoke.
objective: Plant or defuse the bomb, or eliminate the opposing team to win a round.
style: Competitive, realistic presentation with clear maps and sound cues.

title: Valorant
how: Play five-versus-five rounds as agents with different abilities, switching between attacking and defending.
mechanics: First-person gunplay, economy and weapon purchases, agent abilities, and spike plant or defuse objectives.
objective: Win rounds by eliminating the other team or completing the spike objective.
style: Stylized near-future arenas and colorful agents paired with tactical, high-stakes rounds.

title: Fortnite
how: Drop onto an island, gather gear, and survive as the playable area shrinks around the remaining players.
mechanics: Third-person shooting, looting, building in some modes, and squad-based play.
objective: Be the last player or team left standing.
style: Bright, cartoony art with a changing island and frequent themed events.

title: PUBG: Battlegrounds
how: Parachute onto a large map, scavenge equipment, and move toward the shrinking safe zone.
mechanics: Third-person or first-person gunplay, weapon attachments, vehicles, and squad options.
objective: Outlast other players or squads to win the match.
style: Grounded military-inspired maps and tense, high-risk encounters.

title: Dota 2
how: Join a five-player team and battle through lanes toward the opposing teamâ€™s base.
mechanics: Hero selection, ability use, last-hitting for resources, item builds, and coordinated team fights.
objective: Destroy the enemy Ancient while defending your own.
style: Fantasy battlefields with a large hero roster and strategic map control.

title: League of Legends
how: Choose a champion and work with a team to push through lanes and contest map objectives.
mechanics: Champion abilities, minion farming, item purchases, vision, and coordinated team fights.
objective: Destroy the enemy Nexus while protecting your own base.
style: Colorful fantasy characters and arenas built for fast, readable competitive play.

title: Team Fortress 2
how: Join a team and play class-based matches with different objectives and combat roles.
mechanics: Nine character classes, distinct weapons, team coordination, and modes such as payload and control points.
objective: Complete your teamâ€™s map objective before the opposing team does.
style: Expressive cartoon characters and comic exaggeration paired with competitive matches.

title: Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition
how: Guide a civilization from a small settlement to a powerful empire across historical campaigns and matches.
mechanics: Gather resources, build structures, research technologies, and command armies in real time.
objective: Complete campaign missions or defeat rivals through conquest and strategic objectives.
style: Historically inspired maps and armies with refreshed visuals and large-scale battles.

title: StarCraft II: Wings of Liberty
how: Command Terran forces through a science-fiction campaign or compete against other players in real-time battles.
mechanics: Gather resources, construct bases, produce units, scout, and control armies across the battlefield.
objective: Complete campaign missions or defeat an opponentâ€™s forces and base.
style: Cinematic space opera with distinct factions and fast, readable strategic combat.

title: XCOM 2
how: Lead a resistance squad in missions against an alien occupation while managing operations between battles.
mechanics: Turn-based squad combat, cover, class abilities, base management, research, and procedural mission maps.
objective: Build the resistance and disrupt the alien regimeâ€™s plans.
style: Tense science fiction with tactical battlefield choices and high-stakes consequences.

title: Stellaris
how: Create a spacefaring civilization and explore a procedurally generated galaxy filled with other empires and events.
mechanics: Manage planets, research, diplomacy, fleets, and political choices in a real-time grand strategy game.
objective: Guide your empire through the galaxyâ€™s shifting conflicts and long-term challenges.
style: Expansive science-fiction setting with a galaxy map and emergent stories.

title: The Sims 4
how: Create Sims and guide their daily lives, relationships, homes, and personal ambitions.
mechanics: Life simulation, character creation, needs and skills, social interactions, and home building.
objective: Set your own goals and shape the lives and stories of your Sims.
style: Bright, expressive characters and a playful modern setting.

title: Planet Zoo
how: Design a zoo, care for its animals, and keep guests and staff satisfied.
mechanics: Build habitats, manage staff and finances, and balance animal welfare with visitor needs.
objective: Create a thriving zoo that meets its animalsâ€™ needs and remains financially sustainable.
style: Detailed animal habitats and expressive natural environments.

title: PowerWash Simulator
how: Take cleaning jobs and wash grime from objects and locations using a pressure washer.
mechanics: Aim different nozzles, adjust pressure, and clean surfaces methodically to complete each contract.
objective: Finish jobs by removing all dirt from the specified surfaces.
style: Satisfying before-and-after visuals with a calm, low-pressure pace.

title: Microsoft Flight Simulator
how: Fly a range of aircraft across a detailed digital recreation of Earth, choosing routes and weather conditions.
mechanics: Flight controls, navigation, live or preset weather, and aircraft systems at adjustable levels of realism.
objective: Complete flights, practice piloting, or explore destinations around the world.
style: Realistic aircraft cockpits and expansive satellite-derived landscapes.

title: Animal Crossing: New Horizons
how: Settle on a deserted island and shape it over time while meeting animal neighbors.
mechanics: Gather materials, craft, decorate, fish, catch insects, and visit other playersâ€™ islands.
objective: Develop the island and create a home and community that suit your style.
style: Cozy, colorful world with gentle music and a real-time daily rhythm.

title: Terraria
how: Explore a procedurally generated 2D world, gather materials, build, and take on increasingly powerful foes.
mechanics: Mining, crafting, platforming, base building, equipment progression, and boss battles.
objective: Grow stronger and progress through the worldâ€™s bosses and late-game challenges.
style: Colorful pixel art with a wide range of biomes, items, and creatures.

title: The Witness
how: Explore a quiet island and solve line puzzles whose rules are taught through their visual patterns.
mechanics: First-person exploration, environmental observation, and increasingly complex logic puzzles.
objective: Activate the islandâ€™s structures by solving their puzzle panels and uncovering its secrets.
style: Bright, minimalist landscapes with sparse dialogue and a contemplative atmosphere.

title: Baba Is You
how: Solve compact levels by pushing word tiles that define the rules of the world.
mechanics: Rearrange statements to change object properties, control, and win conditions.
objective: Rewrite each levelâ€™s rules to reach its goal.
style: Simple pixel art and word blocks that make its rule-bending puzzles easy to read.

title: The Talos Principle 2
how: Explore a world of advanced puzzles while uncovering the history and debates of a new society.
mechanics: First-person exploration and logic challenges involving tools, energy, and environmental devices.
objective: Solve the puzzles of a mysterious megastructure and decide how its discoveries should be used.
style: Large science-fiction environments paired with reflective conversations and ambient music.

title: EA Sports FC 24
how: Play football matches with club or national teams across solo and online modes.
mechanics: Player movement, passing, shooting, defending, set pieces, and team tactics.
objective: Score more goals than your opponent to win the match.
style: Broadcast-inspired presentation with licensed teams, stadiums, and commentary.
